projections.projection: Authorization should bind workflow steps to authorized actors plus materials/products and commands; integrity is a property of the full execution chain, not a final success bit.
projections.rakl_adoption: Treat the evaluator itself as a content-addressed evidence-producing supply chain with explicit authorized builders and protected inputs.

projections.projection: A result should identify the subject plus build definition, inputs, builder identity and run details; the builder identity represents a transitive trusted platform boundary.
projections.rakl_adoption: Evaluation attestation must bind candidate SHA, evaluator revision, protected materials, command definition, environment specification and authorized builder.

projections.projection: Tools, versions, configuration and environment are causally relevant inputs; implicit host/configuration state undermines reproducibility and validation.
projections.rakl_adoption: The trusted evaluator perimeter includes configuration and environment specifications, not only test source files and workflow YAML.

projections.projection: Agent evaluations explicitly separate scorers/components and use isolated sandboxes; current project discussion also treats scorer blindness to specified metadata/state as an integrity concern.
projections.rakl_adoption: Open a scorer-information-firewall fiber: evaluator visibility must be specified and leak-tested, not assumed from role labels.

projections.projection: LLM belief representations can support sequential query selection by expected information gain rather than query volume.
projections.rakl_adoption: Use as one proposal/prior route for N006, but never let LLM confidence itself certify information gain.

projections.projection: Optimal design can target uncertainty in a scientific QoI or downstream decision instead of globally reducing parameter/model entropy.
projections.rakl_adoption: Upgrade N006 target from generic separation/information gain to decision/QoI-relevant information gain when a downstream QoI is declared.

projections.source: robust Bayesian experimental design and LLM Bayesian-optimization evaluation
projections.projection: Standard Bayesian utility can be brittle under model misspecification, and LLM experiment-design agents can fail to use observed feedback reliably; hybrid designs separate semantic prior/proposal generation from explicit acquisition/update rules.
projections.rakl_adoption: Make robustness-to-belief-misspecification and feedback sensitivity explicit hostile tests; LLM proposes candidates/priors, evidence-updated acquisition governs selection.

projections.projection: Literature, hypothesis generation, experiment proposal, result interpretation and hypothesis revision can be integrated into an agentic research loop.
projections.rakl_adoption: Reinforces existing residual-driven recursive RAKL loop; no new constitutional coordinate retained.

deduplication_notes: Supply-chain attestations, reproducible builds and hermeticity overlap on execution integrity but contribute distinct coordinates: authorization/provenance, environment reproducibility and dependency isolation.
Goal-oriented information gain is not merged with generic entropy reduction because a query can be globally informative yet irrelevant to the declared QoI/decision.
Agent evaluation sandboxing is not treated as scientific evidence authority; it is an evaluator-isolation mechanism.
Robin is recorded as reinforcement rather than semantic novelty because RAKL already contains hypothesis-experiment-residual recursion.
